## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** Word and Excel (desktop, web at `office.com`, or the
  phone apps), and your notes of Lectures 1–7.
- **Time:** about 60 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** each of Steps 1–3 is a simulator: the practice quiz
  shows you what you know, and the two labs repeat the main skills. Then do
  the **Tasks to submit**.
- **What you submit:** one Word file and one Excel file, on the university
  e-learning platform, before lecture 8.
- **Tip:** after each wrong answer, open the notes or the online activity of
  that unit and read the part again.

## Step 1 · The practice quiz {.study}

**In the Practice Quiz:** answer the 14 questions on Units 1–7 (Files, AI,
Word and Excel). Do **All** first, then the part with the most wrong
answers again. The feedback after each answer says the rule. Nothing is
saved or sent.

{{< sim file="sims/practice-quiz.html" poster="sims/practice-quiz.png" title="Practice Quiz: Units 1–7" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Your result"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="nothing|=SUM(B2:B9)"}
What keeps an older copy of your files that a mistake does not reach?
:   a backup

    Why: A backup is an extra copy in a separate place.

An AI answer gives a date that is not in your document. What is it?
:   a hallucination: check and correct it

    Why: AI tools can invent facts that sound right.

Where do you put the page number, so that it is on every page?
:   in the header or the footer

    Why: Insert › Page Number puts it there, on every page.

Which formula gives the biggest number in B2:B9?
:   =MAX(B2:B9)

    Why: MAX finds the largest value.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · Word practice: headings and contents {.study}

**In Contents Builder:** give each heading a heading style, insert the
contents (**References › Table of Contents**), then add a heading and click
**Update Table**. A cover with no page number needs **Different First
Page**.

{{< sim file="../week-04/sims/toc-builder.html" poster="../week-04/sims/toc-builder.png" title="Contents Builder: headings, contents, update" height="620" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Word"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="bold text|Insert › Picture"}
What does Word use to build the contents?
:   the heading styles

    Why: Word builds the contents from Heading 1 and Heading 2.

Where do you insert the contents?
:   References › Table of Contents

    Why: The table of contents is on the References tab.

You added a heading. What do you click?
:   Update Table

    Why: Word does not update the contents by itself.

The cover must have no page number. What do you tick?
:   Different First Page

    Why: The first page gets its own header and footer.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Excel practice: formulas and references {.study}

**In Reference Lab:** copy a formula down with the **fill handle**. A
formula starts with = (`=B2*C2`); copied down, B2 becomes B3, B4 …; a
**\$** keeps a reference, so `=B2*$F$1` keeps F1 in every row.

{{< sim file="../week-06/sims/reference-lab.html" poster="../week-06/sims/reference-lab.png" title="Reference Lab: copy a formula with $" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Excel"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="=B2\*F2|48"}
B2 = 6, C2 = 7. What does =B2\*C2 show?
:   42

    Why: 6 × 7 = 42.

You copy =B2\*\$F\$1 from C2 to C5. What is in C5?
:   =B5\*\$F\$1

    Why: B2 moves three rows down, and \$F\$1 stays.

Which part stays the same when you copy =B2\*\$F\$1?
:   \$F\$1

    Why: The \$ signs keep the address when you copy.

What does the fill handle do?
:   it copies the formula down

    Why: The fill handle copies the formula, and the relative references change.
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

Do the tasks alone. Your teacher marks them (6 marks).

### Task 1 · A short Word report (2 marks)

1. Write a one-page report "My first half of Digital Skills": a title and
   three headings (Heading 1): *Files*, *AI*, *Office*.
2. Under each heading, write two sentences about one thing you learned.
3. Add a table of contents and page numbers in the footer. Save it as
   `review_report.docx`.

### Task 2 · The café week (2 marks)

1. Type the sales of the college café in five days (made up): Sun 30,
   Mon 50, Tue 20, Wed 60, Thu 40 (JD), in A1:B6 with headings.
2. In B7, the total with SUM; in B8, the average with AVERAGE; in B9, the
   best day with MAX.
3. In C2, the part of each day in the week: `=B2/$B$7`, copied down to C6,
   in the Percentage format.
4. Make a line chart of the five days with a real title. Save it as
   `review_cafe.xlsx`.

### Task 3 · Short answers (2 marks)

a) Write the formula in your cell C4, and say why its `$B$7` did not
change.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Which part of the practice quiz was the hardest for you? Which unit will
you study again?

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## How to submit

Upload `review_report.docx`, `review_cafe.xlsx` and your answers to Task 3
to the university e-learning platform, **before lecture 8**.
